gloss: free; flexible; at will; as one pleases

definitions.gloss: free; flexible; at will; as one pleases
definitions.explanation: The ability to act, move, or use something without any restriction, often implying a high level of mastery or skill that allows effortless control.

notes:
Expresses freedom of movement, control, or ability without restriction. The word combines {自|じ} (self) and {在|ざい} (to exist), suggesting being in a state where one can act freely.

USAGE:
- {自在|じざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: freely, at will (most common pattern)
- {自在|じざい}な + noun: free, flexible (adjectival use)
- Often describes mastery or skill — someone who can use something {自在|じざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ has full command of it
- Also used for physical mechanisms that allow free adjustment

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自在|じざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧: to control freely
- {自在|じざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}いこなす→使いこなす：07179_tsukaikonasu⟧: to use with full command
- {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}: endlessly transforming; protean
- {伸縮自在|しんしゅくじざい}: freely expandable and contractable
- {融通自在|ゆうずうじざい}: infinitely flexible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: free, freedom — broader meaning; can refer to social/political freedom
- ⟦{思|おも}いのまま→思いのまま：22133_omoinomama⟧: as one wishes — more casual and subjective
- ⟦{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}→縦横無尽：14074_juuoumujin⟧: freely in all directions — more dramatic and emphatic
